MINECRAFT VERSION UPGRADE DOWNGRADE A newer version reads the world without problems in most cases. Plugins and mods can lag behind though, and some worlds grow features the older code cannot handle. Minecraft worlds and chunks are not backwards compatible. An older version cannot read what a newer one wrote: chunks can be reset, structures and entities can disappear, and a world can end up unusable. Plugins and mods for the newer version will not load either. A backup is mandatory for a downgrade. It is created before anything changes and stays on the phone. A backup is recommended but not required. You can also continue without one.
